payload.title: dispatch_change_intelligence writes a held service seat's change_review_budget_held row only after the seat loop, so a dispatch interrupted after the last seat is minted leaves the row unwritten forever: the next dispatch sees no missing seat and skips the change as already_dispatched before the hold code is reachable
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_tracking.py:522-572 (the seat loop mints every missing seat)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_tracking.py:573-577 (the hold rows for plan.held are written only after that loop)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_tracking.py:480-483 (a re-dispatch with no missing seat is skipped as already_dispatched and continues past the hold code)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_funnel.py:801-815 (hold_change_seat: the seat is 'held, not dropped' through one once-keyed governance row)
payload.rule_violated: WP-D4 'a cap is a hold for its reader, never a silent drop': every touched service past service_seats_per_change is named by one change_review_budget_held row (judgment_funnel.hold_change_seat docstring, genesis_policy_default.json change_review.seats).
payload.notes: A change touches four services with a service cap of three. The dispatch mints the three service seats and the lens seat, then fails before the hold row of the fourth service is appended (a ledger_lock_timeout on the governance append, or the process ending). On the next dispatch all planned seats are already asked, so missing is empty and the change is skipped as already_dispatched; hold_change_seat is never called for it. The fourth service is then neither reviewed nor named anywhere. The reviewer's probe reproduced this with hold_change_seat raising once: four seats minted, zero hold rows, and the second dispatch minted nothing and wrote nothing. Close condition: Write the idempotent once-keyed hold rows for plan.held on the 'no missing seat' path as well (the change was admitted when any seat exists), or write them in the same step as the last seat mint. Add a test in test_se5_seat_routing.py that patches hold_change_seat to raise once on the four-service change and asserts the second dispatch ends with exactly one hold row per held service. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
